title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 5:43-48
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 5:43-48</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="43" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">You have heard that it was said</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        “You shall <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">love</char> your <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">neighbor</char>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        and <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="red">hate</char> your <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">enemy</char>.”
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        <verse number="44" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">But I say to you</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">love</char> your <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="blue">enemies</char>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        and pray for those who persecute you, 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="45" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">so that you may be children</char> of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">your Father who is in the skies</char>; 
      </group>
      <group>
        for he causes his sun to rise on the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">evil</char> and the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">good</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and he sends rain on the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">righteous</char> and the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">unrighteous</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="46" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">For if</char> you <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">love</char> those who <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">love</char> you, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">what</char> reward do you have? 
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">Do not even</char> the tax collectors do the same? 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        <verse number="47" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">And if</char> you greet only your brothers, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">what</char> more are you doing than others? 
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c'">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">Do not even</char> the nations do the same? 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="48" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">Therefore you are to be</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">whole/complete</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        as <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">your Father in the skies</char> is <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">whole/complete</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
